title: Brazil Marks 50th Anniversary of Military Coup: Declassified Documents on U.S. Role
publisher_or_archive: National Security Archive Electronic Briefing Book No. 465
summary: Declassified White House audio recordings of President Lyndon B. Johnson directing aides to 'take every step that we can' to back Brazilian rebel military officers, accompanied by top-secret cables detailing 'Operation Brother Sam'—the dispatch of a US aircraft carrier strike group, 16 tons of tear gas, ammunition, and motor fuel to support the ouster of President João Goulart.
